::: {.letter-metadata}
**Date:** June 22nd [1869]  
**From:** “Monthly Packet” 6, Paternoster Row, London, E.C.  
**Manuscript:** MS Princeton University, Parrish Collection, CO171: Box 29
:::

[Madam](people/person_990.qmd),
I send you herewith the payment for the first half of your pretty story of [Campanella](other_books/otherbook_502.qmd) which I think greatly liked by all the readers of the [Monthly Packet](organizations/other_52.qmd)

Yours truly
C M Yonge
